status: Local implementation authorized; no release approval
source: Robert reports early Campaign Shaman weakness and substantial chip damage; no exact Shaman deck, fight or snapshot supplied. Available retained Campaign histories are Assassin/Golemancer, not Shaman, under .wrangler/testing-0.215-2026-11-06/real-campaign. No relevant Arena exports; owner export credential unavailable. No simulations or measured Shaman outcomes.
basis: Decision 670: restore Thunderbird as third starting totem in Campaign/Arena. Hawk's Dive Common -> Basic and replace one starter Strike, retaining ten cards. No card coefficients changed: Hawk's Dive costs 1 and hits for 7/10, then plants a Hawk. Full starting row makes that first plant push out Hawk for 7 more random damage at zero Spirit. Bear remains 2 Barrier/turn; direct chip protection unchanged. Thunder Memory still plants 1 + prior Thunderbird plants, now 2 from a fresh start instead of 1. Existing decks/offers preserved; rules90 restarts old unfinished battle checkpoints. All30 styles, ten starts and mixed builds reviewed; no new grades assigned.
target: Arena first: distinct competitive styles at1000HP; typical10+ own turns. Drago optimized-deck target roughly50% or somewhat above, pending representative human/deck evidence.

At zero Spirit Thunderbird passively Forks3 to two targets with25% lone-target bonus; long-fight strength depends on row management and acquired growth.
ratings.rationale: Opening pressure and planting efficiency increase, but direct early chip protection does not. No measured grade change. mixedBuilds.name: Freely mixed totems, Spirit, Auras and commands
mixedBuilds.assessment: Shaman bases gain a third starting totem; other classes need acquired plants. Existing Hawk's Dive remains playable, but future normal offers omit it. Growth depends on draw, setup and row management; no guaranteed rare combinations.

mixedBuilds.name: Freely mixed Barrier, sustain, traps and Consume
mixedBuilds.assessment: No native sustain changes. On Shaman, faster kills may reduce HP loss; prioritizing plants can still displace defense. Opening and turns11+ recovery remain unmeasured.

mixedBuilds.name: Freely mixed elemental attacks, summons and weapons
mixedBuilds.assessment: Shaman gains passive starting damage without increasing Mana or changing Attack coefficients. Other class engines unchanged; no free starting Thunderbird from merely acquiring a Shaman card.
